description: Revenue, net income, assets, equity, EBIT, D&A for a Brazilian listed company in your licensed sectors, from its own CVM filings: the annual DFP and the latest quarterly ITR (year-to-date). Derived values (EBITDA, net debt, margins, leverage) are returned separately and labelled estimativa. A company with no CVM filing says so (closed capital or IR-page only) instead of returning numbers. Use for 'what was X's revenue / net income / debt'. Deterministic: computed from official datasets, no model in the loop.

entity.description: Company name or Onça Setorial id, e.g. 'Vale', 'Eletrobras', 'Hypera'.

period.description: Optional. '2025' or '2025-12-31' for the annual DFP; '2T26', '2026Q2' or '2026-06-30' for a quarterly ITR. Default: every statement on file.

name: company_financials
title: Company financials from CVM filings (DFP/ITR)
